_doc: Targets for the recurring supply-chain-gated update lane. gate=auto-upgrade-if-SAFE (human policy 2026-06-27) PLUS min_release_age_days soak (2026-08-08: ≥7 days after publish before upgrade — Hermes/cloudflared especially). See scripts/linuxbox/safe-update-check.sh and CLAUDE.md > Update gate. Do NOT upgrade same-day a release drops.

targets.name: hermes
targets.notes: Nous Hermes Agent. Snapshot version before upgrade; smoke `hermes chat -q ping` after. Soak ≥7d after GitHub release (supply-chain + stability).

targets.name: cloudflared
targets.notes: Edge tunnels (abhinavall + tableslop). After upgrade restart BOTH named units. Soak ≥7d after GitHub release; never same-day chase.

targets.name: mem-constant
targets.notes: Own package, GitHub/source-installed (not on PyPI). Real supply-chain risk is its deps: run pip-audit in the env where it's installed (PC) after upgrade.

targets.name: claude-mem
targets.notes: No version_cmd: npx @latest would download/hang on the 2GB box. Gate relies on npm-registry latest + OSV.

targets.name: dashboard-node-deps
targets.notes: Dashboard server uses Node stdlib only today; audit guards future deps.

targets.name: situation-monitor-python
targets.notes: Dependency-free stdlib runner today; pip-audit guards future deps.
